"""Generated by `bootstrap.py --emit-ci github` — paste into tests/ as test_ci_dfs_gate_wiring.py.

The chain is only as strong as its wiring: gate unit tests can pass while the CI step that calls the
gate has been deleted. This test reads the workflow as TEXT and asserts both steps exist. Pair it with
the repo's existing CI-hardening tests; do not mock the file read.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
WORKFLOW = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml"
STRUCTURE_GATE = "scripts/check_repo_structure.py"


class TestDfsGateCiWiring(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_workflow_exists(self) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(WORKFLOW.is_file(), f"missing workflow: {WORKFLOW}")

    def test_structure_audit_step_is_wired(self) -> None:
        text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        self.assertIn(STRUCTURE_GATE, text)
        self.assertIn("--all", text, "structure audit must run the full graph in CI")

    def test_ratchet_guard_step_is_wired(self) -> None:
        text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        self.assertIn(STRUCTURE_GATE, text)
        self.assertIn("--ratchet-guard", text, "the ratchet guard must be wired next to the audit")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
